summary: The promise-diagnostics run compiled and passed, but both promise and accepted-change logs came back empty while node 4 ended at accepted 37 and decided 38. That is itself informative: node 4 received no Promise and accepted nothing during the 900 randomized actions, so its leadership term and StopSign acquisition fell inside the 150 fair-delivery convergence rounds, which the recorder did not cover. This revision keeps every existing field and comparison and extends the recording window: Promises addressed to pid 4 are recorded with sender, promise ballot, accept round, accepted index, decided index and StopSign flag, tagged by action step during the randomized phase and by `c<round>` during convergence, scanning the queue before both traced deliveries in each round. Node 4's accepted index is also sampled after every convergence round and its transitions recorded with the same prefix. The receipt should now show the promise metadata node 4 actually received when it won leadership and whether a StopSign-bearing promise lost the single max-promise merge, which is the remaining open point in the otherwise explained StopSign-resync account.
